releaseNotes.it:
Supporto multi-linguaggio per analisi nativa C# (.csproj / .cs) e VB6 (.vbp / .frm / .cls / .bas).
Suite analitica ampliata con oltre 20 strumenti architetturali, metriche avanzate (Blast Radius, LCOM4, Hotspot di rischio, MI, SemVer API Diff) e documentazione in-app con formule matematiche.
Ottimizzazioni per il Semantic Code Graph, gestione thread-safe delle relazioni e persistenza istantanea della cache del workspace.
releaseNotes.en:
Native multi-language analysis support for both C# (.csproj / .cs) and Visual Basic 6 (.vbp / .frm / .cls / .bas) projects.
Expanded analytical suite featuring over 20 architectural tools, advanced metrics (Blast Radius, LCOM4 cohesion, Risk Hotspots, Maintainability Index, SemVer API Diff), and formula-rich in-app documentation.
Optimized thread-safe Semantic Code Graph relationship indexing and instant workspace cache persistence.
